action.command: cd /workspace/project && K="cap_live_2a9c30a47d0bbdfde2f4470b61648b0b"; R=$(curl -s --max-time 30 -X POST https://api.capbypass.pro/createTask -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"clientKey\":\"$K\",\"task\":{\"type\":\"ReCaptchaV3TaskProxyLess\",\"websiteURL\":\"https://dash.allmodels.io/login\",\"websiteKey\":\"6LfevBIuAAAAABj4MatLSIOOPOFa_IBz1nG6veLh\",\"pageAction\":\"claim_credit\"}}"); echo "create: $R"; TID=$(echo "$R" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('taskId',''))" 2>/dev/null); echo "taskId: $TID"; for i in $(seq 1 20); do sleep 2; S=$(curl -s --max-time 25 -X POST https://api.capbypass.pro/getTaskResult -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"clientKey\":\"$K\",\"taskId\":\"$TID\"}"); echo "[$i] $(echo $S | head -c 200)"; echo "$S" | grep -q '"status":"ready"\|"SUCCESS"' && { echo "SELESAI"; echo "$S" > /tmp/cb.json; break; }; done
